stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Graham Lewin leads on 18 pts - and unlike the Broncos, showing no sign of a hangover

stories.title: Logjam
stories.detail: 3 tied at the top on 18 - countback territory

stories.title: The Great Escape
stories.detail: Dennis Lawson in with 15 pts - a last-hole reprieve, the cellar stays empty for him

stories.title: Relatively Good Golf
stories.detail: the Francis name is having a day - Rodney and Ian both up and about

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - level with the lead

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: The club extends a warm welcome to Robert Oliver from Cowra GC. Play well and enjoy the Bidgee.

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 8 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 7, 8 & 9 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: The Grind
stories.detail: 3 1-pointers in a row on holes 7, 8 & 9

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 8 & 9

stories.title: The Bounce Back
stories.detail: Wipe then a 3-pointer on holes 6 & 7

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 5, 6 & 7 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: One Step Forward...
stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 5, 1-pointer on hole 6

stories.title: Two's Company
stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 4 & 5 - this is momentum

stories.title: One-Point Parade
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 2, 3 & 4 - sticking to the 1-point script

stories.title: Hero to Zero
stories.detail: 3-pointer then a wipe on holes 2 & 4 - feast then famine

stories.title: Footy Form Guide
stories.detail: David Bussenschutt finished 13 pts at 1.4 a hole - the bar is the only trophy today
